# Gan Jing Campus

> Gan Jing Campus is an ad-free learning platform for children ages 4–16 and their teachers. Content is curated by educators and screened by Ethical AI. Teachers get a free Teacher Premium Channel, and parents get a free 30-minute screen reset guide. It is a project of Gan Jing World, launched in December 2023.

Gan Jing Campus runs on Gan Jing World (ganjingworld.com): videos, teacher channels and the camp are hosted there, and this website explains the program in English and Traditional Chinese.

Key facts:

- Audience: children ages 4–16, their parents, and K–12 teachers.
- Ad-free: no commercials or ad-driven recommendations.
- Safety: three layers of review. Ethical AI filters harmful, violent and inappropriate material; trained educators and content specialists check age-appropriateness and educational value; parents, teachers and community members can flag anything that slips through.
- For teachers (free): a Teacher Premium Channel with playlists, curation tools, custom hashtags, a royalty-free music library and live teaching tools; a free handbook course; and Certified Digital Educator (CDE) status.
- Teachers in 6 continents use it; classroom stories come from the US (Boston, New York), Taiwan, Indonesia and elsewhere.
- Kindness projects: #KindnessIsCool and the #BeKindBeCool Kindness Awards (2026–27 entries close March 31, 2027), with winning work shown on a Times Square billboard.
- Gan Jing Kids is a separate, optional paid family membership on Gan Jing World (7-day free trial, then US$6.99/month). Gan Jing Campus's teacher tools are free.
- Contact: creators@ganjingworld.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ganjingcampus.org/): what Gan Jing Campus is, who it is for, and FAQs
- [For Teachers](https://ganjingcampus.org/teachers): the free Teacher Premium Channel, the CDE path, subject resources and the #BeKindBeCool School Edition
- [Free Parent Guide](https://ganjingcampus.org/free-guide): the 30-Minute Family Screen Reset, a free guide for parents who want healthier screen habits without banning technology
- [Kindness Stories](https://ganjingcampus.org/kindness): real classroom stories and the #BeKindBeCool Kindness Awards
- [About](https://ganjingcampus.org/about): mission, the three-layer safety model, and who runs the program
- [Privacy & Safety](https://ganjingcampus.org/privacy-and-safety): how content is reviewed, what data this site collects, and where to ask privacy questions
- [Summer Camp Recap](https://ganjingcampus.org/summer-camp): the free 8-week online summer camp for ages 4–16, with weekly themes and 100+ curated films and shows
